description: This stacked horizontal bar chart, titled “QA-2,” compares the performance of two models—“EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” and “RedWhale (our)” —across three categories: “Correct,” “Partially Correct,” and “Incorrect,” as indicated by the legend using dark purple, medium blue, and light blue colors respectively. The vertical axis lists the model names, while the horizontal axis represents performance values, which are displayed as numerical labels within each segment of the bars; the scale is linear and the values are shown without explicit tick marks or units, but the numerical labels indicate percentages or proportions. For “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” the “Correct” segment is dark purple and measures 92.9, the “Partially Correct” segment is a medium blue with a value of 1.4 (visually appearing as a small grayish bar), and the “Incorrect” segment is light blue and measures 4.3. For “RedWhale (our),” the “Correct” segment is dark purple and measures 95.7, the “Partially Correct” segment is medium blue and measures 1.4, and the “Incorrect” segment is light blue and measures 2.9. The bars are arranged horizontally with the model names on the left and are not sorted; the “RedWhale (our)” bar is visually longer than the “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” bar, indicating a higher total performance score. The chart does not include any shading, bolding, or annotations beyond the numerical labels within the segments.
